name: Buga (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, green and red.
history: Municipal flag of Guadalajara de Buga, a municipality in the department of Valle del Cauca, Colombia; Spanish Wikipedia records the tradition that it is the flag carried by José María Cabal at the Battle of Alto Palacé and sworn by Nariño's armies on 20 July 1813, the same design as the 1812 flag of the State of Cartagena.
